To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Kap95 is involved in the nuclear import of three transcription factors that regulate Start, Swi4, Mbp1 and Swi6.
the classical nuclear import is necessary for the cell cycle progression at G1.
Kap95 is required to drive the nuclear import of the Start transcription factors Swi4, Mbp1 and Swi6, which is mediated by specific nuclear localization signals in cargo proteins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of Kap95 in the regulation of gene expression at the initiation of cell cycle.
a novel role for the classical nuclear import machinery in the cell cycle regulation.
the identification and characterization of a novel role of β-karyopherins in cell cycle control at Start.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Kap95 is essential for cell cycle progression, at least at Start.
the nuclear import of the three transcription factors at Start is mediated by Kap95 and that the inactivation of this karyopherin produces a block in the cell cycle at Start.
KAP95 is required for the nuclear import of the three main transcription factors involved in the Start transition of the cell cycle in S. cerevisiae.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the classical nuclear import machinery is required for the expression of the genes that initiate the cell cycle in S. cerevisiae.
the classical nuclear import mediated by Kap95 is required at Start.
the classical nuclear import machinery is involved in the regulation of the G1/S phase of the yeast cell cycle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nuclear import mediated by Kap95 is essential at Start.
the classical nuclear import is required for the activation of the cell cycle in S. cerevisiae.
the control of the sub-cellular localization of the transcriptional machinery is crucial for cell cycle regulation.
